reading.action: Set the lit lantern by the maul and meditate, channeling its heat into the core to rekindle it as high as it'll go; then attach the winding-drum core to the free end of the chain and whirl Burning Anger at full extension like an overlong dervish flail, trying to use the core's force to augment the spin.
reading.result: TWO-PART, SAFE platform, deterministic (iris-prep ruling). PART 1 REKINDLE: a real lit lantern is an external heat source, so his focus paid only the channeling (not the heat) and the core climbed higher than the t74 heatless-threshold meditation could -- LOW -> MODERATE/working-high (NOT brimmed: capped by the widened reservoir + the small hooded lantern's modest output). Lantern drawn conservatively -> dimmed to a lower steady burn but STAYS LIT (he won't kill the light he needs; that stop is the cap). Focus 120 -> 90 (-30). Core feeds flame-techniques from its own supply again -> ember-amped offense usable into floor 5; FREE re: the reset clock. PART 2 DERVISH EXPERIMENT -- ruling (C) HYBRID on (A) physics, NOT (B): the unbound core is dead rotational MASS on the chain and mechanically augments a new UNWIELDY dervish-flail attack mode (reach + heavy momentum, high-risk: hard to control/stop, can overbalance; MIGHT 14 + FIN 14 govern) -- a harmless stumble on safe stone as he learns it. The STORED FORCE stays LOCKED (foreign +0 AND unbound -- both gates unmet) -> Stored-Force 0, NO affinity tick. SEED/TELL: first faint direct feel of the foreign force under spin (it torques/resists unlike dead mass, a sealed want he can sense but not touch) -> real + locked behind a BIND he hasn't made; binding is the next reach. Orthogonality HONORED (two unmerged axes on one tool; ember-sense slides off the core). HELD DARK: the axis name/ladder/deeper capability. system_card None (no progression). Stamina 76 -> 66 (-10 dervish-flail practice). HP 124 unchanged. Core MODERATE; winding-drum core affixed to the chain-end (reversible attachment, not fused). FUTURE-BIND spec pre-staged in the runbook only. Ch5 OPEN. NO Tower reset.
